parsed.rationale: Three distinct enum types — `PlaybackBlendMode`, `MaterialBlendMode`, and `OverlayBlendMode` — all live in the same `Wallpaper` package and each carries an identically-shaped `blendMode` computed property at exactly line 62 of their respective files, flagged as `function-duplicates-exact`. Because all three records have all context flags false (no test, mock, sample-app, or codegen markers), there is no restraint reason to leave the duplication in place. The idiomatic Swift resolution is to introduce a `BlendModeConvertible` protocol with a `blendMode` requirement and provide a single default implementation in a protocol extension, eliminating the three redundant bodies. A new file `BlendModeConvertible.swift` in the same `Wallpaper/Core` directory keeps the change self-contained within the existing package.
